title: BharatAI Academic Opportunity Intelligence Platform Architecture & Knowledge Item
summary: Comprehensive architectural and operational Knowledge Item for BharatAI: India's AI-powered academic opportunity intelligence platform. Covers Field Notes Neubrutalist visual redesign, persistent TopNav navigation bar across public and protected routes, FastAPI backend, Next.js 14 frontend, PostgreSQL database seeding (test students & admins), Redis offline resilience fallback, FAISS + Elasticsearch storage layers, zero-shot BART domain classifier, spaCy NLP resume parser, weighted relevance personalization feed, 1000-point InCoScore merit engine, anti-gaming velocity checks, multi-channel notification engine (Email + WebSocket), feature flag canary rollout system, and Docker/CI/CD deployment setup.
